name: SiPhotonIC
description: SiPhotonIC is a DTU spinout providing rapid-prototyping silicon photonic integrated circuit foundry services with 1.5-3.5 month turnaround using DTU Nanolab cleanroom facilities. The company serves both classical optical communications and quantum photonic clients, enabling fabrication of single-photon source chips and quantum photonic integrated circuits. SiPhotonIC is a Quantum Business Network member and Danish Quantum Community partner.
funding: Privately held; DTU Centre of Excellence for Silicon Photonics spinout
